description: Start a research session (keywords, SERP, gaps, evidence, AI visibility, run in parallel). Async: returns immediately — poll get_job_status (type: research), then get_research for results.

competitor_domains.description: Domains to analyze (used with type=competitor or gap)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. 'us'). Falls back to site country.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code (e.g. 'en'). Falls back to site language.

query.description: Topic or question to research (max 500 chars)

site_id.description: Site providing brand/language/country defaults. Use list_sites for IDs.

type.description: Default 'general' (full analysis). 'topic' maps subtopics; 'competitor'/'gap' add type-specific context.

name: start_research
